integrity: Original graph enumeration and an independently encoded coordinate-state enumeration reproduced all tested distances and invariants. Proof is self-contained; historical priority has an unindexed-literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to three-row open rectangular grids and fixed terminals at the middle-row endpoints, with states restricted to minimum separators and moves to adjacent grid vertices; it proves no token-jump metric or higher-width analogue. Finite checks supplement an all-length proof.
title: Exact Manhattan mobility of minimum separators in three-rail grids
